addcaps() { sudo python3 - $B/config.json "$@" <<'PY'
import json, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
d = json.load(open(p))
for caps in d["process"]["capabilities"].values():
    for c in sys.argv[2:]:
        if c not in caps:
            caps.append(c)
json.dump(d, open(p, "w"), indent=2)
PY
}
# nginx skips the chown when the directories already belong to its user; the workers still have to drop to it
for d in client_temp proxy_temp fastcgi_temp uwsgi_temp scgi_temp; do sudo chown 101:101 $B/rootfs/var/cache/nginx/$d; done
addcaps CAP_SETUID CAP_SETGID
start
